decisions.reason: As a visible 2023 line extension with several models that fits the firm's design-led core drainage business and black-bathroom positioning, management is likely to justify the investment and keep it unless demand clearly weakens.

This shower channel is closely tied to the firm's announced direction toward modern, seamless and barrier-free bathroom solutions, so its strong strategic fit and public launch make continued support the more likely choice.

Although the recent pump-drain channel sits nearer a riskier niche and a related pump product was already removed, its 2024 launch is too recent for management not to attribute any disappointment to ramp-up effects and continue for now.
